name: @dsh-external/dsh-campaign-memory
description: Cross-session campaign memory for the pentest / code-audit presets: model-side write/search/get/list/remove tools storing raw content verbatim (credentials may be stored as-is or as pointers to existing local vaults), a marker-tagged per-workspace recall block injected into every assembly, preview-capped retrieval with on-demand full-text fetch, usage-ranked with expiry for detection fingerprints, a loopback web channel, and a per-session tab for browsing, searching and curating memories.
